Title: Management experience updates for Azure Cosmos DB are now available

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB has two important updates that improve the management experience for Azure Cosmos DB. The first update includes a new Azure CLI that provides full support across all Azure Cosmos DB APIs including SQL (Core) API, Cassandra, MongoDB API, Gremlin API, and Table API. The other update is a new Azure Resource Provider version that includes support for provisioning SQL API containers with stored procedures and triggers.

Learn more about the new Azure Resource Provider version

Learn more about Azure CLI
